::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Feb 8th [1899?]  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
:::

[Sir](people/person_1652.qmd),
I am moved to say something from my own personal knowledge in defence of rustic reading

I do not care whether this is inserted as a letter, but I should like the substance to appear, as I know it to be fact, and I think it is true of many other Hampshire villages[^1]

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: It sounds as if this may have enclosed a letter to the *Author*, the organ of the [Society of Authors](organizations/other_44.qmd).
